question: How many target languages produce a complete, correctly timed dub end to end?
answer: Five: te, kn, hi, mr, bn -- every language this deployment has a SYSPIN voice for.
method: scripts/e2e_dub.py drives the real API exactly as the frontend does: create, presigned upload, confirm, process, poll, download. All seven stages run. STORAGE_BACKEND=local throughout.
what_is_not_yet_measured: hi, mr and bn have no read-back CER. --asr-check needs Whisper large-v3 (~3.5 GB) and both model-holding workers were resident; scoring it means stopping them and re-verifying with --project <id> --asr-check. The structural checks above prove the dub is complete and correctly placed, not that the words are right.
not_dubbable_here: ta, ml, gu, pa, or, as -- /api/capabilities reports tts_available=false for all six because SYSPIN has no voice for them, and POST /api/projects refuses them with 422 rather than failing at the synthesize stage.
